recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No core source correction is needed for FHIR-32310; any future diagram cosmetic cleanup should be handled by the publisher or regeneration process rather than hand-editing ResearchStudy SVG output.
issue_request: FHIR-32310 was a Published/Persuasive R5 BRR technical correction reporting that several ResearchStudy value set names, including ResearchStudyTitleType, ResearchStudyFocusType, ResearchStudyClassificationClassifier, ResearchStudyPartyType, ResearchStudyPartyOrganizationType, ResearchStudyStatusActivity, ResearchStudyArmType, and ResearchStudyUrlType, did not resolve to functional links.
initial_application: The issue was previously applied through commits 65fb5622, 7786d436, and d421b227, merged by PRs #1951, #1969, and #1970. Those commits created or separated ResearchStudy terminology sources and value sets such as research-study-party-role, research-study-focus-type, research-study-classifiers, research-study-party-organization-type, and research-study-arm-type; PR #1970 explicitly says J#32310 was completed.
additional_context: ResearchStudy is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source no longer contains the old unresolved names from the Jira request, and related issues FHIR-32312, FHIR-32313, FHIR-32316, and FHIR-33053 explain the naming and terminology cleanup path. The checked-in ResearchStudy SVG still contains generated-looking diagram markers such as '??' for some example bindings, but the hrefs point at value set pages and the authoritative XML/value set sources are correct.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current ResearchStudy bindings use canonical valueSet URLs for the still-current local value sets and THO value sets, local value set source files exist where needed, and R5 published value set pages for the issue-listed links resolve.
